title: The Ship Comes Home

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Ahoy, my friend! I got your letter, and here I am, home from a long voyage!

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: The hold is full of all sorts. Would you help sort the cargo? Fruit in the sacks, fish in the barrel, shells in the basket.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.prompt: Sort the cargo: each kind in its own place.
steps.hint: Look at the picture on each place.

feedback.mismatch: That doesn't belong there. Look again.
feedback.all_good: Shipshape! Every bit of cargo in its place.

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: Apples from the islands, fish from the deep, and shells from a beach far away. Every voyage brings home treasure!

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: I read your letter on the ship, you know. Every word! I'll tell you all about the sea this fortnight.

journal_line: I helped Captain Mara unload her ship when she came home.
